choices.content: The perpendicular segment is the shortest
The line segment between two points is the shortest path
Through a point outside a line, there is exactly one line parallel to the given line

question.prompt: Why does a carpenter need to fix only two points when snapping an ink line?

solutions.explanation: Once two points of the ink line are fixed, there is only one line passing through them, so its position is determined. This is based on the fact that “two points determine a line.”
solutions.title: Apply uniqueness of the line through two points
